method: Non-destructive rollback rehearsal: preserve a branch at a previously successful deployed commit, verify that commit remains reachable, and document the production rollback command/path without repointing main during normal operation.
procedure: Confirm the current deployment is unhealthy and identify the prior known-good commit.
Move main back to the known-good commit using GitHub ref update.
Allow the single Pages workflow to deploy that commit.
Verify Home, Watch Earth, one embedded provider, and one external-provider route.
Only then resume forward fixes from a new commit.
note: The rollback rehearsal branch points at the known-good deployed commit. Production main was not rolled back because the live site is healthy.
